_meta.notes: The 3 Item cards from Heros_training_cards_items.pdf (p.7), x3 copies of each. Item abilities are movement/economy modifiers; effects are the authoritative rules text pending engine wiring (movement graph). Eometh starts the game with a Horse.

items.name: Boat
items.ability: You may move along a water path by playing 1 card of any terrain. You may also move between the Grey Havens and Belfalas as if they were connected, at a cost of 3 cards of any terrain.

items.name: Horse
items.ability: Reduce the card cost of each path you move along by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

items.name: Elven Cloak
items.ability: After Sauron plays a Shadow card on your turn, discard 1 influence from the Shadow Pool.
